name: Basilica of St. Edward
history: Fr. Felix Clarkson, a Jesuit, led the parish when ground was broken on Easter Sunday, 4 April 1926. The first Midnight Mass was held that Christmas, and Bishop Patrick Barry dedicated the church on 13 February 1927. A $1.2 million restoration under Msgr. Thomas Klinzing won preservation awards. The Vatican named it a minor basilica, effective 13 December 2024, one of the newest in the country.
arch: Spanish Renaissance, built of cast stone with combed stone ashlar under a Spanish tile roof, with two towers and three sets of bronze doors.
features: A 28-foot Carrara marble Sacred Heart altar stands in a niche more than 40 feet tall.
The window over the entrance depicts St. Edward; side chapels honour St. Anthony and St. Thérèse.

look.d: Spanish Renaissance towers over Palm Beach.
The stained glass over the entrance shows the church's patron, St. Edward the Confessor.
Three sets of bronze doors open into the nave.

fun: It became a basilica in December 2024, almost a century after its dedication.
journal: Palm Beach. Cast stone, tile roof, and a marble altar taller than a house.
